name: @kickside/security-ui
title: KickSide Security
description: Roles, scopes, and policy composition admin web component for kickside/security.

wippy.description: Roles and scopes admin surface for kickside/security, mounted by the host as <kickside-security> with no props (the props schema is an empty object). The rail lists security scopes: built-in groups and registry scopes are read-only, DB-backed custom scopes are editable, and any scope can be copied into a new custom scope pre-filled with its policies. Selecting a custom scope (or New) opens a two-pane builder where public policies are added from a searchable palette into the scope, reordered, and removed; saving writes the scope row through the security admin API and a projection service materializes it as a security.scope registry entry. Emits only the standard bridge lifecycle events (load, unload, error); no custom events.
